metadata.title: NoteFinder – see the notes a singer hits
metadata.description: See the exact vocal notes a singer hits in any song on a timeline synced with playback, and get real-time pitch feedback from your mic.

home.title: Find the notes of any song
home.description: See every vocal note on a timeline synced with the music, and sing along with real-time pitch feedback.

featured.timelineLabel: A vocal line from C4 to G4

signUp.title: Hit every note.
signUp.description: See the exact notes of any song on a timeline and get real-time pitch feedback while you sing.

verifyEmail.title: One code away.
verifyEmail.description: We just need to know this email is yours. It keeps your account and your practice history safe.

setupUsername.title: Make it yours.
setupUsername.description: Your username is your public profile, where your favorite songs and practice streaks live.

signIn.title: Pick up where you left off.
signIn.description: Your favorite songs, practice streak and pitch history are waiting for you.

forgotPassword.title: It happens.
forgotPassword.description: We'll email you a code to reset your password. Your songs and practice history stay safe.

resetPassword.title: Back in tune.
resetPassword.description: Choose a new password and you are ready to sing again.

username.label: Username
username.hint: Letters, numbers and underscores, 3 to 50 characters.

errors.invalid: Use only letters, numbers and underscores.

signUp.metaDescription: Create your NoteFinder account to save favorite songs, track your practice and sing with real-time pitch feedback.
signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: Save your favorite songs, keep a practice streak and sing along with pitch feedback.
signUp.googleError: We couldn't sign you in with Google. Try again or use your email.

signIn.metaDescription: Sign in to NoteFinder to see your favorite songs, keep your practice streak and sing with real-time pitch feedback.
signIn.title: Sign in to NoteFinder
signIn.description: Use your email or username to get back to your favorite songs and practice streak.

verifyEmail.title: Check your inbox
verifyEmail.description: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to <email></email>. It expires in 10 minutes.
verifyEmail.resent: New code sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

missing.title: Start with your account
missing.description: Create your account first and we'll email you a verification code.

setupUsername.title: Choose your username
setupUsername.description: It's how other singers find you on NoteFinder. You can change the suggestion.

forgotPassword.metaDescription: Forgot your NoteFinder password? Enter your email and we'll send you a code to choose a new one.

request.title: Forgot your password?
request.description: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a 6-digit code to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: If <email></email> has an account, we sent it a 6-digit code. It expires in 10 minutes.
reset.resent: If this email has an account, a new code is on its way. Check your spam folder too.

missing.title: Request a code first
missing.description: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a code to reset your password.
